post.description: The post, page or custom post type entry whose applicable fields are wanted.

provider.description: Whose field vocabulary these identifiers belong to. This dispatcher also serves Advanced Custom Fields, whose keys look nothing like Meta Box meta keys, so a client has to be told which it is holding.

target.description: The post the fields were listed for, echoed so a response can be matched to its request.

fields.description: The top-level fields that apply to this post, in the order Meta Box reports them, group by group. Only fields whose group's assignment rules match this post appear. Sub-fields are not listed: they are addressed through their parent.

id.description: The field's id, WHICH IS THE META KEY the value is stored under. This is the identifier every other Meta Box operation takes.

name.description: The field's name, which in Meta Box is the human label shown in the editor and addresses nothing. May be empty.

type.description: The Meta Box field type, for example text, select, or group.

required.description: Whether Meta Box marks the field required in the editor.

groupId.description: The identifier of the field group this field belongs to, as metabox-group-list reports it.

groupTitle.description: That group's title, as shown in the editor. May be empty; Meta Box does not require one.

fieldListingNotices.description: Anything the listing could not report faithfully, such as an applicable field group whose field definitions could not all be read. Names groups and counts only, never a field's value.
